title: PlayerDrones
description: A datapack that adds drones to your minecraft world!
body:
🚁 Minecraft Drone Datapack
Take to the skies with your very own craftable drone! 🌤️ Explore and scout the world from above like never before.

✨ Features:
- 🛠️ Craftable Drone: Easily craft your drone and get ready for flight.
- 🎮 Drone Mode: Right-click the drone to start piloting it and see the world from a bird’s-eye view.
- ⏹️ Exit Drone Mode: Hold Left Shift to exit the drone mode at any time.

⚠️ Warning: While controlling the drone, your armor 🛡️ may remain visible to other players. It’s recommended to remove your armor before taking flight for full invisibility.
